mapper.select: SELECT a.patch_id FROM test_acceptance_patch a JOIN prd_patch p ON p.id = a.patch_id WHERE a.generation_id = #{generationId} AND a.issue_index = #{index} AND p.status IN ('PENDING', 'APPLIED')
SELECT a.issue_index FROM test_acceptance_patch a JOIN prd_patch p ON p.id = a.patch_id WHERE a.generation_id = #{generationId} AND p.status = 'APPLIED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_acceptance_patch(generation_id, issue_index, patch_id) VALUES (#{generationId}, #{index}, #{patchId}) ON CONFLICT (generation_id, issue_index) DO UPDATE SET patch_id = EXCLUDED.patch_id
mapper.select: SELECT result::text FROM test_generation_report WHERE prd_version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_generation_report(prd_version_id, result) VALUES (#{versionId}, #{result}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (prd_version_id) DO UPDATE SET result = EXCLUDED.result, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO test_case (id, prd_version_id, scenario, preconditions, steps, input_data, expected_result, case_type, source_block_id, created_at) VALUES
(#{c.id}, #{c.prdVersionId}, #{c.scenario}, #{c.preconditions}, #{c.steps}::jsonb, #{c.inputData}, #{c.expectedResult}, #{c.caseType}, #{c.sourceBlockId}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, prd_version_id, scenario, preconditions, steps::text AS steps, input_data, expected_result, case_type, source_block_id, created_at FROM test_case WHERE prd_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY case_type, scenario
